queries: WITH status_rates AS (SELECT si.healtheval, AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS rate, COUNT(DISTINCT si.zoneregistry) AS site_count FROM scans AS sc JOIN sites AS si ON sc.zoneref = si.zoneregistry GROUP BY si.healtheval), all_statuses AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS average_rate FROM status_rates) SELECT AVG(sr.rate) AS average_rate, AVG(sr.site_count) AS average_distinct_sites, AVG(sr.rate - a.average_rate) AS average_excess_rate FROM status_rates AS sr CROSS JOIN all_statuses AS a WHERE sr.rate > a.average_rate;

WITH status_stats AS (SELECT si.healtheval, AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS rate, COUNT(DISTINCT si.zoneregistry) AS site_count FROM scans AS sc JOIN sites AS si ON sc.zoneref = si.zoneregistry GROUP BY si.healtheval), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS average_rate FROM status_stats) SELECT AVG(ss.rate) AS average_rate, AVG(ss.site_count) AS average_site_count, AVG(ss.rate - o.average_rate) AS average_excess_rate FROM status_stats AS ss CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE ss.rate > o.average_rate;

WITH status_rates AS (SELECT si.healtheval AS health_status, AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS rate, COUNT(DISTINCT si.zoneregistry) AS site_count FROM scans AS sc JOIN sites AS si ON sc.zoneref = si.zoneregistry GROUP BY si.healtheval), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS all_status_rate FROM status_rates) SELECT AVG(sr.rate) AS average_rate, AVG(sr.site_count) AS average_distinct_sites, AVG(sr.rate - b.all_status_rate) AS average_excess_rate FROM status_rates AS sr CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE sr.rate > b.all_status_rate;
